notes.title: Hoops VR v1.1 Update!
notes.content:
Today's update changes the way scores are tallied in Hoops VR.  We noticed users were requesting more of a benefit to being on a hot streak, so now, whenever you make a basket while on fire, that basket is worth 2 points!

We realize this change will generally increase scores, and somewhat invalidate the current state of the leaderboards, but we think it adds a bit more excitement and strategy to the game. We've been super impressed with some of the high scores out there, and we look forward to seeing how far you can take it with this update.

Stay tuned for more updates, and thanks for playing Hoops VR!
